messages.subject: tabByCol: physical positions
parts:
> Dear Karl:
>
> I have just used the new tabByCol format for summary.scanone() and it's
> handy. The thing that would make it totally convenient would be automatic
> interpolation of mbp positions, which as I remember it is on the todo list.
> Is something already available than interpolating by hand?
>
>
> LEo

Indeed, this has been implemented...

You need a "map" object containing the physical positions of the markers. (Typically, I would start out with this.) The procedure is something like the following:

# load data with markers at physical positions (preferably in Mbp)
mycross <- read.cross("csv", "", "mycross.csv")

# estimate genetic map
gmap <- est.map(mycross)

# shift genetic map so things start at 0 cM
gmap <- shiftmap(gmap)

# pull out the physical map
pmap <- pull.map(mycross)

# insert the genetic map into the cross
mycross <- replacemap(mycross, gmap)

# calc.genoprob; scanone
mycross <- calc.genoprob(mycross, step=1)
out <- scanone(mycross, method="hk")

# interpolate scanone positions to physical positions
out.pmap <- replacemap(out, pmap)

# summaries
summary(out, format="tabByCol", threshold=3, expandtomarkers=TRUE)
summary(out.pmap, format="tabByCol", threshold=3, expandtomarkers=TRUE)

karl
